verdict.rationale: The README documents a short install quickstart with several paths: two /plugin commands, copying the skill folder into a skills directory, or uploading a zip under Settings → Capabilities → Skills. It ends with a check step (start a new session and ask for a logo). The brevity suggests a sub-five-minute setup, but no time is stated or measured. Missing for 10: an explicit or hands-on timing of the under-five-minute claim, independent corroboration that the install works first try, and documented prerequisites or troubleshooting.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes

citations.quote: Copy the skill folder into your personal (all projects) or project skills directory
upload it under Settings → Capabilities → Skills.
Start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.
